name: TinyDuino LightMeter - Hardware Sensory Workbench
description: Hardware light meter workbench and agentic sensory skills for TinyDuino, BLE112, and KY-018 photoresistor, powered by WebMCP and ShadowClaw.

skills.name: daylight-harvest
skills.description: Energy-saving daylight harvesting coordinator calculating artificial light offsets based on live TinyDuino lux.

skills.name: dusk-trigger
skills.description: Detect true physical dusk and twilight using TinyDuino live illuminance rather than clock-based estimates.

skills.name: lightmeter
skills.description: Read live ambient illuminance from the TinyDuino KY-018 sensor, classify lighting conditions, and display metrics.

skills.name: nightlight
skills.description: Monitor ambient darkness and control TinyDuino Pin 13 / Pin 7 LEDs as an automatic reactive nightlight.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, edit, review, and validate ShadowClaw declarative skills and their supporting resources.

skills.name: tinyduino-doctor
skills.description: Automated troubleshooting doctor diagnosing Web Bluetooth connection failures, BlueZ GATT errors, and CCCD timing.

skills.name: tinyduino-status
skills.description: Comprehensive hardware diagnostic inspecting connection state, packet counts, last ACK, and sensor telemetry.

tools.name: tinyduino_ambient_level
tools.description: Lightweight sensory check returning current ambient light level, lux, category, and Matter 0x0400 cluster MeasuredValue for smart home automation.

tools.name: tinyduino_connect
tools.description: Trigger Web Bluetooth connection dialog or activate simulated hardware.

tools.name: tinyduino_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from TinyDuino Web Bluetooth GATT server or deactivate simulation.

tools.name: tinyduino_get_connection_status
tools.description: Inspect the current transport mode (connected, disconnected, simulated), device name, and packet counters.

tools.name: tinyduino_get_status
tools.description: Return current TinyDuino connection state, LightMeter A0 telemetry, auxiliary sensor values, and recent samples without transmitting a new BLE packet.

tools.name: tinyduino_read_light
tools.description: Trigger an immediate analogRead(A0) on the TinyDuino KY-018 photoresistor over Web Bluetooth GATT Handle 17, and return the live LightMeter metrics (raw A0, voltage, brightness %, and estimated lux).

tools.name: tinyduino_read_telemetry
tools.description: Return snapshot of raw ADC, voltage, brightness %, estimated lux, and lighting category.

tools.name: tinyduino_render_surface
tools.description: Render or embed the interactive TinyDuino LightMeter control panel inside an agent chat or UI surface.

tools.name: tinyduino_send_command
tools.description: Send an arbitrary ASCII command string (e.g. LIGHT, STATUS, LED_ON, RATE:500, PING) to TinyDuino over GATT Handle 17.

tools.name: tinyduino_send_raw
tools.description: Send raw hexadecimal bytes (e.g. '80 0c 00 00' or '01') to TinyDuino over GATT Handle 17.

tools.name: tinyduino_set_led
tools.description: Control the TinyDuino onboard LED (Pin 13) and ASD2009 Proto Board LEDs. Modes: ON (force ON), OFF (force OFF), or AUTO (automatic BLE state blink).

tools.name: tinyduino_stop_stream
tools.description: Stop continuous A0 LightMeter telemetry streaming from the TinyDuino.

tools.name: tinyduino_stream_light
tools.description: Start continuous A0 LightMeter telemetry streaming from TinyDuino and optionally set sampling interval in ms (250, 500, 1000).

scripts.name: tinyduino-adapter
scripts.description: Portable ESM engine logic and tool execution handler for tinyduino-adapter.

scripts.name: tinyduino-ble
scripts.description: Portable ESM engine logic and tool execution handler for tinyduino-ble.

scripts.name: tinyduino-element
scripts.description: Portable ESM engine logic and tool execution handler for tinyduino-element.

scripts.name: tinyduino
scripts.description: Portable ESM engine logic and tool execution handler for tinyduino.
